description: Phase 2+3: New base components (T2-T6) and screen redesigns (T10-T13). Creates HeroCarousel, CategoryHeroRow, ProductGridCard, CartItemRow, LoyaltyCard, then rewires CartaScreen, PedidoScreen, AccountScreen, HomeScreen. Depends on FEAT-001 for new color/spacing tokens. Independent of FEAT-003 (roulette cinematic) and FEAT-004 (rewards backend).
steps: T2 — Read mobile-client/src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx. Modify tabBarStyle: backgroundColor to Colors.surfaceElevated, borderTopColor to Colors.goldBorder, add elevation:16, iOS shadow props (shadowColor:'#000', shadowOffset:{width:0,height:-2}, shadowOpacity:0.3, shadowRadius:8). Change height to Spacing.tabBarHeightNew + insets.bottom. Change active indicator View to width:40 height:3. Add tabBarLabelStyle: {fontSize:10, letterSpacing:0.3, marginTop:1}. Import useCartStore. In tabBarIcon for Pedidos tab: if cartCount>0 render a View badge (absolute top-right, 16x16, borderRadius:8, backgroundColor:Colors.badgeRed) with Text showing cartCount.

T3 — Create mobile-client/src/components/HeroCarousel.tsx. FlatList with ref, horizontal, pagingEnabled, snapToInterval=screenWidth, decelerationRate='fast'. useRef for flatListRef. setInterval(3200ms) in useEffect that calls scrollToOffset. Animated dots row: Array of Animated.Values for opacity. Fallback: when slides.length===0 render a single placeholder slide with gradient background. Props: slides:Array<{id:string,imageUri?:string,title:string,subtitle?:string,onPress?:()=>void}>, height?:number (default Spacing.heroCarouselHeight).

T4 — Create mobile-client/src/components/CategoryHeroRow.tsx. Horizontal ScrollView (contentContainerStyle gap Spacing.sm, paddingHorizontal Spacing.gutter). CATEGORY_COLORS map: {cocktail:'rgba(168,85,247,0.15)', vino:'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)', cerveza:'rgba(245,158,11,0.15)', comida:'rgba(52,185,100,0.15)', 'sin alcohol':'rgba(56,189,248,0.15)', shot:'rgba(249,115,22,0.15)', general: Colors.goldMuted}. Each pill: width/height Spacing.categoryPillSize (72), borderRadius:Radius.full, centered icon (use Text emoji as placeholder) + Text label. Active pill: borderWidth:2, borderColor:Colors.cardBorderActive. Animated.spring for scale on active (1.08). Last pill is Ruleta (gold color, RotateCw icon from lucide-react-native). Props: categories:Array<{id:string,name:string}>, activeCategory:string, onSelect:(id:string)=>void, onRuletaPress:()=>void.

T5 — Create mobile-client/src/components/shared/ProductGridCard.tsx. Card width is 100% (parent FlatList handles 2-col). Image with aspectRatio:4/3, borderRadius:Radius.lg top corners. Heart icon (absolute top-right, onPress calls onFavorite). Bottom section: product name (Typography.labelLg), price (Colors.primary). Qty stepper row: minus/plus TouchableOpacity with Animated.spring press scale. When cartQty===0 show only a '+' Add button. props: product:ProductPublicDTO, isFavorite:boolean, cartQty:number, onAdd:(p)=>void, onRemove:(p)=>void, onFavorite?:(p)=>void, onPress?:(p)=>void.

T6 — Create mobile-client/src/components/shared/CartItemRow.tsx. Horizontal View: Image 56x56 (borderRadius:Radius.md) on left. Middle: product name (flex:1), notes in smaller text. Right: stepper. When item.quantity===1 and user presses minus, show Trash2 icon (calls onRemove). Props: item:CartLine, onIncrement:()=>void, onDecrement:()=>void, onRemove:()=>void.

T10 — Read mobile-client/src/screens/CartaScreen.tsx. Replace ScrollView+manual sections with FlatList numColumns=2. ListHeaderComponent renders: screen title row, SearchBar (existing inline search code extracted), CategoryHeroRow (with current categories and active state). renderItem uses ProductGridCard. keyExtractor by product.id. columnWrapperStyle with gap Spacing.gridGap. ItemSeparatorComponent with height Spacing.gridGap. Keep FloatingCartBar, ModifierModal, ProductCustomizerSheet, NToast, NEmptyState. ListEmptyComponent uses NEmptyState. Remove the old SommelierCard/CompactProductRow from the list body (they can stay imported).

T11 — Read mobile-client/src/screens/PedidoScreen.tsx. In CartView: replace manual cart.map item rendering with FlatList or map using CartItemRow from ../components/shared/CartItemRow. Add estimated time badge in CartView header: View with Clock icon (16px, Colors.info) + Text '~15 min · Entrega estimada', styled like mesaBar. Add UpsellRow after the cart items: horizontal FlatList, load top 3 featured products (call getPublicProducts in useEffect inside CartView, filter p.featured&&p.available, slice(0,3)), render each as a compact 120x80 card with name and +Add. Update submit button label to use 'Confirmar Pedido' prefix.

T12a — Create mobile-client/src/components/shared/LoyaltyCard.tsx. Full-width card (backgroundColor Colors.surfaceContainerHigh, borderRadius Radius.xl, overflow hidden). Diagonal overlay: absolutely positioned View (200x200, backgroundColor Colors.goldSubtle, transform:[{rotate:'-15deg'}], top:-40, right:-40). Level map: balance<500=Bronze, 500-1999=Silver, 2000-4999=Gold, 5000+=Platinum. Each level has color and emoji. ProgressBar: Animated.Value driven width from 0 to percentage of next threshold. Card number row: Text '•••• •••• ' + userId.slice(-4) in monospace style. Props: balance:number, totalEarned:number, userId:string.

T12b — Read mobile-client/src/screens/AccountScreen.tsx. Import LoyaltyCard. Import usePointsStore from '../stores/usePointsStore'. In the main useEffect (alongside fetchHistory), call usePointsStore.getState().loadPoints(). Add LoyaltyCard after heroContainer View and before liveOrderBanner: <LoyaltyCard balance={pointsBalance} totalEarned={pointsTotalEarned} userId={user?.id ?? ''} />. Get pointsBalance and pointsTotalEarned from usePointsStore state.

T13 — Read mobile-client/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx. Change topBar backgroundColor to NocturneColors.surfaceElevated. Replace <PromoBanner>/<PromoBannerFallback> with <HeroCarousel slides={promos.map(p=>({id:p.id,title:p.name,subtitle:p.description,onPress:goToCarta}))} />. Replace the 'Explorar la carta' CategoryPills block with <CategoryHeroRow categories={categories} activeCategory={selectedCategory} onSelect={handleCartaCategory} onRuletaPress={()=>setShowRoulette(true)} />. Remove the QuickActionCard row (the 4-icon grid). Add 'Lo más pedido' section after CategoryHeroRow: <FlatList numColumns={2} data={featuredProducts.slice(0,4)} renderItem={({item})=><ProductGridCard ...>} columnWrapperStyle={{gap:Spacing.gridGap}} />. Limit Sommelier to first 2 items: featuredProducts.slice(0,2). Redesign Roulette CTA: replace right-side RotateCw button with <MobileWheel drinks={drinks} spinAnim={new Animated.Value(0)} size={80} /> where drinks state is imported from the roulette fetch. Add a local drinks state: const [idleWheelDrinks, setIdleWheelDrinks] = useState([]) with a useEffect calling getPublicRouletteDrinks.
acceptance_criteria: AppNavigator tab bar height is tabBarHeightNew(72)+insets.bottom, has gold border top, elevation 16
Cart count badge renders on Pedidos tab when cart has items
HeroCarousel auto-advances every 3200ms and shows animated dots
CategoryHeroRow renders pills of 72x72 with category colors and a Ruleta pill
ProductGridCard renders 4:3 image, heart, qty stepper
CartItemRow shows trash icon when qty=1 and decrement pressed
CartaScreen uses FlatList numColumns=2 with ProductGridCard renderItem
PedidoScreen CartView uses CartItemRow for cart items
LoyaltyCard shows Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum level based on balance
AccountScreen shows LoyaltyCard after hero section
HomeScreen top bar uses surfaceElevated, has HeroCarousel, CategoryHeroRow, Lo más pedido section
findings: All 13 tasks implemented. expo-linear-gradient not installed so gradient overlay uses a plain View with opacity instead. StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject replaced with absoluteFill (correct RN API). ProductPublicDTO import added to PedidoScreen. All acceptance criteria met; npx tsc --noEmit exits 0.
